stem: ![](asset:P000400-stem-1) Two cars A and B are moving on perpendicular roads as shown in the figure. Their respective speeds 10 m/s and 20 m/s. At an instant, they are at a distance of 60 m and 80 m from the intersection point. What will be the angular velocity of car B as seen from car A at the instant shown.

assets.alt: Two perpendicular roads crossing. Car A is 60 m from the crossing, moving towards it at 10 m/s; car B is 80 m from the crossing on the other road, moving towards it at 20 m/s.
